title: Deeply Optimized
description: A deeply optimized lightweight modpack for up to 6× more FPS.
body:
![Thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8cc998a5303a22d8744170efefe9a9e63f23424.png)

## 💡 About Deeply Optimized
**Deeply Optimized** is a **lightweight**, **client-side** performance modpack built for one purpose:  
**to make Minecraft run as fast and smooth as possible.**  
No visual changes. No QoL mods. No extra features.  
A **clean**, **lean**, and **minimal** setup designed for players who want **higher FPS**, **faster loading**, and a **stable vanilla-like experience**.

## 🚀 Why Deeply Optimized?

Deeply Optimized focuses entirely on **pure performance**:

- ⚡ **Massive FPS improvements**  
- 🎯 **Smoother and more faster loading**  
- 🧠 **Reduced memory usage**  
- 🪶 **Lean, lightweight, and minimal**  
- ✨ **Zero Bloat**  
- 💻 **Fully Vanilla-Compatible**  

**No visuals.  
No gameplay changes.  
No unnecessary mods.  
Just performance.**

## 🔧 Key Features

- 🚀 **Maximum FPS Boost**  
Carefully selected optimization mods tuned to **eliminate stutter**, reduce micro-lag, and significantly improve framerate.

- 🪶 **Ultra-Lightweight**  
A **lean** and focused mod list with **zero clutter** — quick startup, instant world loading, and easy updates.

- ⚡ **Faster Load Times**  
Optimized loading pipeline delivers **faster game startup** and **quicker world entry**.

- 💻 **Fully Compatible**  
100% client-side and non-intrusive.  
Doesn’t modify or interfere with **any vanilla mechanics**.

- 🧩 **Perfect Foundation**  
Add visuals, QoL mods, shaders, or HUD improvements on top — the **performance core stays fast, stable, and reliable**.

## 🏷️ Versioning System
Deeply Optimized follows this version format:

`[ModpackName] - [MinecraftVersion] - [Build] - [Stage]`
